description: Register one MCP server connection once, referenced by name (server_resource_key) from mcp_tool_call/mcp_tool_picker and the MCP-capable agent components instead of repeating the same connection fields inline in every one of them.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Dagster resource key other components reference via server_resource_key.

name.label: Name
name.description: Short label for logs and the mcp-server tag/metadata other components stamp on their own assets.

url.label: Url
url.description: http / sse: full URL of the MCP endpoint.

headers_env.label: Headers Env
headers_env.description: http / sse: map of header_name -> env_var_name (value read from env at call time).

inspection_asset_name.label: Inspection Asset Name
inspection_asset_name.description: `f"If set, ALSO emits an asset by this name: connects to the configured server at materialization time and lists its real tool names + descriptions as metadata (tool_names, tool_descriptions, tool_count). `allowed_tools` (on agentic_pipeline's tool_use_loop, and on the litellm/openai/anthropic/gemini/vercel_ai_gateway/snowflake_cortex agent components) matches against the NAMESPACED name '<server name>__<tool name>' -- this asset's tool_names metadata lists the bare names; prefix each with this resource's own `name` + '__' to write an allowlist pattern. Leave unset to skip this -- existing resource-only behavior is unchanged."`

inspection_timeout_seconds.label: Inspection Timeout Seconds
inspection_timeout_seconds.description: inspection_asset_name only: bounds connect + handshake + list_tools.
